name: Guilford County, NC
findings: Guilford County has 2,045 nonprofit organizations. 770 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 589 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Guilford County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: 25 professional organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 61 would.
